items.title: Injectivity of the omega-fixed central-extension presentation inside the universal central extension of sl(n)[u^{+-1},v]
items.author: Mamoru Ueda
items.source_version: Official SIGMA 22 (2026), 089 publisher native source retrieved 2026-10-13
items.difficulty_reason: The author builds explicit root generators and central terms for the omega-fixed presentation, proves linear independence of their images, and then uses a graded degeneration and the positive current-algebra presentation to establish spanning. Both the central extension and the infinite family of root/current relations are essential to injectivity. This is a structural PBW argument for a toroidal fixed-point algebra beyond ordinary qualifying-exam Lie algebra exercises.
